The comparison examines the age at diagnosis (Alder ved diagnose) for patients across Denmark and its five regions, based on data from the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1]. The analysis covers the national average alongside regional breakdowns for [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src1].

Because the data is drawn from a single time point, no longitudinal trends can be established regarding whether the age at diagnosis is increasing or decreasing over time [^src1]. Furthermore, the dataset does not define specific clinical targets or thresholds for the age at diagnosis, meaning no targets are met or missed [^src1].

Across all regions and the national average, the mean age at diagnosis is remarkably consistent, standing at exactly 74 years everywhere [^src1]. The median age is equally uniform at 76 years across the entire country and all five regions [^src1]. The standard deviation (spredning) is also highly consistent, recorded at 12 years nationally and in four of the five regions, with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] being the sole exception at 11 years [^src1].

When examining the extremes, outliers emerge in the minimum and maximum ages. Nationally and in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], the minimum age at diagnosis is recorded as 0 years [^src1]. In contrast, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] stands out as a significant outlier with a minimum age of 18 years, while [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] report minimums of 13 and 9 years, respectively [^src1]. On the upper end, the national maximum age is 106 years, driven by [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src1]. The other regions peak slightly lower, with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] reaching 105 years, and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] trailing with a maximum of 104 years [^src1]. The total number of patients with known ages (uoplyst is 0 across all rows) is 19,671 nationally, with [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] contributing the largest regional cohort of 5,241 patients and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] the smallest with 2,202 patients [^src1].

## Table: AFDK_2023.pdf, p. 85

Rows compare: region · Columns show: gennemsnit, spredning, median, minimum, maximum, uoplyst, antal

| Region | Gennemsnit | Spredning | Median | Minimum | Maximum | Uoplyst | Antal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Danmark | 74 | 12 | 76 | 0 | 106 | 0 | 19671 |
| Region Hovedstaden | 74 | 12 | 76 | 0 | 106 | 0 | 5241 |
| Sjælland | 74 | 11 | 76 | 18 | 105 | 0 | 3202 |
| Syddanmark | 74 | 12 | 76 | 13 | 105 | 0 | 4580 |
| Midtjylland | 74 | 12 | 76 | 9 | 104 | 0 | 4446 |
| Nordjylland | 74 | 12 | 76 | 0 | 105 | 0 | 2202 |

Entities: region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland, databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark

Summary: Tabellen viser, at gennemsnitsalderen ved diagnose er ens på tværs af regioner (74 år), mens variationen i minimumsalder varierer mellem 0 og 18 år.
